scope.evaluation_window: the complete 2026-11-19 UTC development partition; no window selection after inspecting results
scope.evaluation_interval: [2026-11-19T00:00:00Z, 2026-11-20T00:00:00Z) by OAF recorder receive time; valid monotone OAF frames outside this interval are counted and skipped before payload normalization
scope.training_window: [2026-11-15T12:00:00Z, 2026-11-15T13:00:00Z) by OAF recorder receive time; distinct development data used only to create the frozen G3 occupancy artifact
scope.training_window_selection: fixed engineering interval selected before the new training audit and evaluation; not selected from observed scores, agreement, or traffic
scope.training_cap_policy: strict existing G3 input limits; an audit or train cap refusal is INCOMPLETE and creates no model; no partial training or raised-cap retry
scope.comparison_unit: each decoded 2026-11-19 SFDPS row, plus an exact-receive-time candidate track state when available
scope.interpretation: G3 empirical-occupancy transfer proxy and separate same-input flight-state propagation diagnostic; neither establishes controller intent or legal geometry
scope.input_selection: predeclared one-hour distinct Nov 15 training interval and complete Nov 19 evaluation day; no post hoc window selection, model refit, or threshold search
scope.timing_limit: source, receive, candidate state, candidate source, and candidate input-availability clocks remain distinct; no physical output-publication latency is claimed
scope.run_profile: recorded-peak-v1; one 24-hour day, no raster rendering
scope.memory_bound: at most 32 stream readers with one OAF frame buffer and 4 KiB input chunk each; per stream at most 4096 pending messages or 4 MiB payload; one adapted OAF message at a time; one runtime frame at a time; runtime state is bounded by the listed profile caps; aggregate output retains only fixed-size counters and at most 32 input digests
scope.exhaustion: any cap, parser refusal, gap, or capacity error prevents a complete marker; processed prefixes are never a complete-day result

identity.match_key: exact positive GUFI carried by both the decoded row and candidate FlightKey
identity.source_locator: stream, decoded byte offset, recorder sequence, and row index are provenance only
identity.missing_or_conflicting_identity: count as not comparable; never infer a key from time, order, owner, or address

time.candidate_time: candidate state timestamp, newest source timestamp, and newest input-availability timestamp are separate required values
time.candidate_state_rule: latest already-produced state with state_ns <= SFDPS receive_ns; state age must be <= 1 second; compare before processing the next issue tick
time.future_candidate_state: not comparable when candidate state or input availability is later than SFDPS receive time; no ceil/future tick or predicted position is used
time.stale_candidate_position: not comparable when the newest candidate position source timestamp predates the SFDPS message source timestamp
time.candidate_position_state: latest causal state at or before SFDPS receive timestamp, at most 1 second old
time.output_availability: not available from the current track output type; no physical publication delay is estimated

sector_assignment.prediction: the unique supported owner label for the latest causal candidate track state at or before SFDPS receive time, no more than 1 second old, using WGS-84 position and reported altitude in the frozen 2026-11-15 G3 model
sector_assignment.contested_unknown_missing_stale_future_o: explicit non-agreement disposition; never excluded from row denominator
sector_assignment.interpretation: held-out empirical occupancy transfer proxy only; not official boundary accuracy, physical sector geometry, probability, or controller decision

flight_data_state.interpretation: same-input message-scoped propagation diagnostic; no independent amendment event or controller action is generated

flight_data_amendments.coverage: Unobservable as an independent amendment comparison: current SFDPS rows provide published values, while no independently keyed candidate amendment event stream is supplied
flight_data_amendments.rule: value snapshots must not be relabeled as amendment events

alerts.legacy_source: not present in SFDPS migration projection
alerts.coverage: Missing unless a separately validated legacy alert feed is supplied

interface_messages.coverage: Unsupported until an observable ICD-backed encoder/output stream exists

classification.better_requires: attached independent review evidence tied to the exact pair and this profile version
classification.worse_requires: attached independent review evidence tied to the exact pair and this profile version
classification.missing_unknown_invalid_unsupported_stal: NotComparable and blocks qualification; never counted as agreement
classification.g3_supported_owner_mismatch: Unresolved pending exact-pair independent review; never excluded or counted as equivalent

noninferiority_limits.meaning: strict engineering screening limits, not FAA acceptance thresholds

denominator_rules.every_decoded_row: accounted as matched-GUFI, missing-GUFI, identity-mismatch, or invalid-clock
denominator_rules.every_compared_source_field: accounted as present, absent, malformed, unsupported, candidate-unavailable, candidate-not-yet-available, candidate-not-modeled, equivalent, or unresolved-different
denominator_rules.g3_occupancy_rows: every SFDPS row is classified as supported-match, supported-mismatch, contested, unknown-support, no-training-cell, candidate-unavailable, identity-mismatch, invalid-time, future-state, stale-state, unknown-availability, invalid-position, missing-altitude, invalid-altitude, stale-position, or unknown-source-owner; counts must sum to the evaluation row total
denominator_rules.flight_data_amendments: unobservable coverage is reported explicitly and cannot qualify as a pass
